_about: Charts refresh_to_week.py must never extend, and the week each one is expected to end on. 'discontinued' charts stopped publishing: a request past 'until' serves no heading and no rows. 'not_billboard' charts come from another source and have their own refresher. tests/test_freshness.py holds each discontinued chart to exactly its 'until' week instead of Billboard's latest. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
